blocks.text: Rust 编译的 WASM 字节暂存区和 JSON ⇄ MessagePack 转码器。它提供 8 字节对齐、地址稳定的 arena 分配，以及只在字节边界工作的同步转码 API；不跨 WASM 边界传递 JavaScript 对象图。
包内包含 wasm-pack 生成的 ES module 和 `.wasm` 资源。修改 Rust 实现后，用 `pnpm run build` 重新生成 `src/`；build 随后通过 scripts/finalize-glue.ts 给既有 finalizer 加入一次发布规则，不手工编辑生成文件。

blocks.code:
import init, {
  alloc_bytes,
  ptr_of,
  byte_len_of,
  dealloc_bytes,
  json_to_msgpack,
  msgpack_to_json
} from '@migaia/wasm'

blocks.text: `alloc_bytes(byteLen)` 返回新分配 id（或 `0`）；`ptr_of(id)` 返回字节指针；`byte_len_of(id)` 返回按 8 字节取整的容量；`dealloc_bytes(id)` 显式释放并返回是否确实存在。死 id 的读操作返回 `0`，释放操作返回 `false`。
转码函数都返回同一次操作绑定的 `ConversionResult`：

blocks.code:
import type { ConversionResult } from '@migaia/wasm'
declare const result: ConversionResult
result.id // 成功时的新输出分配，失败时为 0
result.len // 精确输出长度，失败时为 0
result.error // 成功为空串，失败为原因
result.free() // 独立释放 wasm-bindgen 结果元数据，不释放输出 arena

blocks.text: `msgpack_to_json` 具有对称签名。输入必须是单个完整文档；尾随非空白字节会失败。成功和失败都只通过当前返回值报告，不存在全局“上一次结果”或兼容别名，因此两个调用的结果可以安全地交错保存。输入分配不会由转码自动释放。每次成功和失败的结果元数据均须 free()；元数据与 arena 分配是两个独立的所有权。
`json_to_msgpack` 保持 map key 为字符串并直接从 reader 转到 writer，不先构造 `serde_json::Value`；`msgpack_to_json` 同样保持单文档边界。

arena 使用 `Vec<u64>`，保证指针适合 `Float64Array`/`BigInt64Array`。WASM memory 增长会使旧 `ArrayBuffer` 视图失效；每次分配或读取前都从当前 `memory.buffer` 创建视图。所有分配都必须显式释放；`@migaia/store-wasm` 另外提供 FinalizationRegistry 兜底，但不替代确定性 dispose。

sections.heading: 高阶组合示例 · 交错转码并在一个所有权边界内释放全部分配

blocks.text: 每次转码返回独立的 `ConversionResult`，因此可以先保留多个结果，再按业务顺序读取。输入 id 和成功结果 id 都归调用者所有；用 `try/finally` 把释放收拢到同一个边界，避免异常路径泄漏 arena 分配：
每次读取前都重新访问 `wasm.memory.buffer`，因为后续分配可能触发 memory growth 并使旧视图失效。`.slice()` 得到 JavaScript 自有副本后即可释放 WASM 输出；如果要保留零拷贝视图，就必须把对应 id 的释放延后到最后一次读取之后。

blocks.code:
pnpm run build       # wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ../src
pnpm run test        # wasm-pack test --node rust，再运行 JS glue 回归
pnpm run test:rust   # cargo test（Rust 原生单元测试）
pnpm run typecheck   # 生成声明和包配置检查

blocks.text: 生成的 glue/声明/WASM 先由 wasm-pack 覆盖，再由 TypeScript build 后处理固定首个 exports 的发布，避免晚完成的 init 替换已交付 memory。发布或验证前应执行一次确定性重复构建，并通过真实 WASM host 和 packed consumer 导入/实例化测试。
转码的往返保真限于 JSON 数据模型及可表示数值；任意 MessagePack 的 bin/ext、非 JSON map key 和超出 JSON 数值范围的整数不保证可逆，可能被改写或拒绝。JSON 对象直接走 map 序列化，不依赖 struct-map 配置。
本文记录当前单一 WASM ABI。Rust arena 和转码函数由 `@migaia/wasm` 负责；`@migaia/store-wasm` 只负责字段分配、数值视图和生命周期，不复制 arena 或转码状态机。

默认入口通过包内 `wasm_provider_bg.wasm` 初始化。同一模块只发布第一份完成初始化的 exports；并发 init 的返回值和具名 wrapper 共用该 memory/arena。并发实例化工作仍可能发生，不承诺同一个 Promise 或只编译一次。Node 等不支持相对 fetch 的宿主应传入 `BufferSource` 或 `WebAssembly.Module`。同步入口不发起 fetch。

rows: 8 字节对齐、清零的稳定分配 id，失败为 `0`
当前线性内存中的字节偏移，未知 id 为 `0`
实际容量（按 8 字节取整），未知 id 为 `0`

blocks.text: `0` 是保留哨兵。分配使用稳定 id 并避免覆盖仍存活的块；指针只保证到释放前稳定。WASM memory 增长会替换 `memory.buffer`，所以 typed array 不能跨越后续分配调用复用。

blocks.code:
// ConversionResult 是具名 JS wrapper 返回的元数据类，还需显式 free()。
declare const result: ConversionResult
result.id
result.len
result.error
result.free()

declare function json_to_msgpack(id: number, len: number): ConversionResult
declare function msgpack_to_json(id: number, len: number): ConversionResult

blocks.text: 每个调用都构造独立 `ConversionResult`，把输出 id、精确输出长度和错误绑定到同一操作；不存在共享的结果寄存器，因此交错调用不会互相覆盖结果。成功为 `{ id: nonzero, len: exactBytes, error: '' }`，失败为 `{ id: 0, len: 0, error: reason }`。输出和输入 arena id 都由调用者用 dealloc_bytes 释放；每次成功或失败返回的 ConversionResult 元数据还须独立调用 free()。free() 不释放输出 arena，dealloc_bytes 不释放结果元数据。init 返回的 InitOutput 是 raw WASM ABI；不要对它调用转码后把数字结构指针当 ConversionResult。使用导入的具名 JS wrapper。
转码只读取指定分配的前 `len` 个字节，并拒绝未知 id、超过容量的长度、空文档、格式错误和尾随第二个文档。JSON 允许文档后的空白；MessagePack 必须精确消费输入。map key 以字符串保存，避免 schema 依赖。

错误内容保持现有调用方可诊断的前缀：未知分配或超容量为 `unknown allocation id or length past capacity`，arena 无法分配输出为 `arena exhausted`，JSON/MessagePack 解析错误分别带 `json to msgpack failed:` 或 `msgpack to json failed:`。这些文本存在于返回值内，不通过第二个查询 API 读取。
空输入、非法输入、多个连续文档和超出实际容量的长度都会返回 `id: 0`。失败不会创建可供调用者释放的输出块；输入块仍由调用者拥有，失败返回的元数据仍需 free()。
字段 owner 通过 `ensureWasm()` 复用同一个初始化 Promise，并在显式 dispose 时释放自己的分配；构造失败时先完成所有已创建资源的回滚，再保留原始错误。record 字段只接受 number，并使用当前 `memory.buffer` 上的 `DataView`。这些生命周期语义不依赖转码结果 ABI，也不引入第二种 shared-buffer layout。

symbols.purpose: Default async initializer imported as init; fetches the bundled wasm asset when omitted, or instantiates application-provided bytes/module. Call before any allocation or conversion. The first completed initialization publishes the exports; concurrent calls return that same memory/arena as named wrappers. Concurrent instantiation may still occur: Promise identity and single compilation are not promised.
symbols.core:
module_or_path: Application module source: `RequestInfo`, `URL`, `Response`, `BufferSource` or precompiled `WebAssembly.Module`; wrap it in `{ module_or_path }` to avoid deprecated positional initialization.
Promise of `InitOutput`. Native WebAssembly.CompileError, WebAssembly.LinkError and WebAssembly.RuntimeError cross unchanged without source/code under the registered native pass-through exception. Loading failures reject; the package defines no custom error codes.

error: Empty string on success. Failure is unknown allocation id or length past capacity, arena exhausted, or text prefixed json to msgpack failed:/msgpack to json failed: with parsing details.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Initialized native exports: memory plus raw numeric ABI functions. Named JS imports wrap metadata pointers and boolean results; prefer those wrappers for normal conversion.

sections.title: 上手

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
memory: Native `WebAssembly.Memory` shared with the arena; reread memory.buffer after any call that can allocate or grow memory.
alloc_bytes: Raw byte allocator taking requested byte count; returns an arena ID, zero on exhaustion. Memory growth requires fresh typed-array views.
alloc_bytes.a: Application-requested unsigned 32-bit byte count.
Owned arena ID, or zero on allocation failure.
byte_len_of: Raw capacity query accepting an arena identifier and returning its eight-byte-rounded capacity, or zero for an unknown ID.
byte_len_of.a: Live allocation identifier returned by `alloc_bytes` or a successful `ConversionResult.id`, in this initialized module.
Allocated capacity in bytes, not the encoded document length.
ptr_of: Raw arena pointer query returns a stable eight-byte-aligned byte offset until deallocation, or zero for an unknown ID.
ptr_of.a: Live allocation identifier returned by `alloc_bytes` or a successful `ConversionResult.id`, in this initialized module.
Byte offset into current memory, not an arena ID.
dealloc_bytes: Raw arena release returns numeric one for a removed live allocation and zero for an absent ID; the named JS wrapper returns boolean.
dealloc_bytes.a: Live allocation identifier returned by `alloc_bytes` or a successful `ConversionResult.id`, in this initialized module.
Numeric native boolean; subsequent release of the same ID returns zero.
json_to_msgpack: Raw JSON converter returns a result-struct pointer, unlike the named JS wrapper json_to_msgpack which returns ConversionResult. Prefer the wrapper for owned metadata.
json_to_msgpack.a: Live allocation identifier returned by `alloc_bytes` or a successful `ConversionResult.id`, in this initialized module.
json_to_msgpack.b: Exact number of input bytes written by the application, no greater than `byte_len_of(id)`; rounded capacity is not a document length.
Raw metadata pointer managed by generated glue; use the named wrapper for safe metadata access and free().
msgpack_to_json: Raw MessagePack converter returns a result-struct pointer, unlike the named JS wrapper msgpack_to_json which returns ConversionResult. Prefer the wrapper for metadata ownership.
msgpack_to_json.a: Live allocation identifier returned by `alloc_bytes` or a successful `ConversionResult.id`, in this initialized module.
msgpack_to_json.b: Exact number of input bytes written by the application, no greater than `byte_len_of(id)`; rounded capacity is not a document length.
Raw metadata pointer; the named wrapper constructs and owns its ConversionResult.
conversionresult_id: Raw metadata getter receives a result-struct pointer and returns its output arena ID; use ConversionResult.id instead of handling raw pointers.
conversionresult_id.a: Raw result-struct pointer returned by the corresponding `InitOutput` conversion function; never pass an arena allocation identifier here.
Output arena ID, zero on conversion failure.
conversionresult_len: Raw metadata getter receives a result-struct pointer and returns exact output byte length; use ConversionResult.len for normal consumers.
conversionresult_len.a: Raw result-struct pointer returned by the corresponding `InitOutput` conversion function; never pass an arena allocation identifier here.
Exact output bytes, zero on conversion failure.
conversionresult_error: Raw metadata getter copies UTF-8 error text into a temporary allocation and returns pointer/length. Generated glue decodes and frees that temporary; use ConversionResult.error.
conversionresult_error.a: Raw result-struct pointer returned by the corresponding `InitOutput` conversion function; never pass an arena allocation identifier here.
A [bytePointer, byteLength] tuple for generated glue, not a JavaScript string.

symbols.name: initSync
symbols.signature: export function initSync(module: { module: SyncInitInput } | SyncInitInput): InitOutput;
symbols.purpose: Synchronously initializes from bytes or a precompiled native module without fetching. Use the object input form; already initialized modules return their existing exports.
symbols.core:
module: Application `SyncInitInput` wrapped as `{ module: bytesOrModule }`; positional bytes/module remain accepted but emit a deprecation warning.
An `InitOutput`; native WebAssembly.CompileError, WebAssembly.LinkError and WebAssembly.RuntimeError retain their type, identity and stack without source/code, as the registered pass-through exception.

symbols.name: json_to_msgpack
symbols.signature: export function json_to_msgpack(id: number, len: number): ConversionResult;
symbols.purpose: Synchronously transcodes exactly one UTF-8 JSON document to MessagePack within the arena; trailing JSON whitespace is accepted. Pair with alloc_bytes and dealloc_bytes to own input and output separately. Preservation is limited to JSON data and representable numbers.
symbols.core:
id: Live allocation identifier returned by `alloc_bytes` or a successful `ConversionResult.id`, in this initialized module.
len: Exact number of input bytes written by the application, no greater than `byte_len_of(id)`; rounded capacity is not a document length.
An owned `ConversionResult`: success has nonzero id, exact len and empty error; invalid ID/length, parsing/trailing-document or allocation failure has id/len zero and error text. Input stays owned by the caller.

symbols.name: msgpack_to_json
symbols.signature: export function msgpack_to_json(id: number, len: number): ConversionResult;
symbols.purpose: Synchronously transcodes exactly one MessagePack document to UTF-8 JSON, rejecting any trailing bytes. Pair with dealloc_bytes to release the new output allocation; bin/ext, non-string map keys and out-of-range integers are not promised reversible JSON forms.
symbols.core:
id: Live allocation identifier returned by `alloc_bytes` or a successful `ConversionResult.id`, in this initialized module.
len: Exact number of input bytes written by the application, no greater than `byte_len_of(id)`; rounded capacity is not a document length.
An independently owned `ConversionResult`; zero id/len and error text report failure without throwing a package error. Each successful output and every input remain separately releasable.

symbols.name: ptr_of
symbols.purpose: Looks up the byte offset for one live arena ID. Pair with alloc_bytes and initialized memory to construct a fresh typed-array view; offset stability does not preserve an old memory.buffer after growth.
symbols.core:
id: Live allocation identifier returned by `alloc_bytes` or a successful `ConversionResult.id`, in this initialized module.
Eight-byte-aligned offset valid until this allocation is released; unknown or dead IDs return zero.
